spec.title: Kubernetes / Cluster Health
spec.description: At-a-glance Kubernetes cluster health. Portable across cluster sizes: node readiness is a ratio, node metrics join through node_uname_info, and disk uses any ext4/xfs/btrfs mount rather than Talos-specific paths.

spec.title: Cluster

spec.expr: (count(kube_node_info) - count(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"} == 1)) + (count((kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"} == 1) unless on(namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Succeeded"} == 1)) or vector(0)) + (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) or vector(0)) + (count(up{job=~"apiserver|kubelet|kube-state-metrics|.*node-exporter|cilium-agent|kube-dns|coredns"} == 0) or vector(0))

spec.description: Counts not-ready nodes, unhealthy pods, firing alerts, and down control-plane scrapes.

spec.title: Nodes ready
spec.description: Ready nodes / total nodes. Green only when every node is Ready — works for any cluster size.

spec.title: CPU

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - avg((rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~".*node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))

spec.description: Average CPU of Kubernetes nodes only (joined via node_uname_info).

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - sum((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) / sum((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))

spec.title: Disk (fullest volume)

spec.expr: max(((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))

spec.description: Hottest ext4/xfs/btrfs mount on any Kubernetes node. Not tied to Talos /var paths.

spec.expr: max by (nodename) (((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(100 * (1 - avg by (nodename) ((rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~".*node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(100 * (1 - sum by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) / sum by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(max by (nodename) (((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

spec.title: Control plane scrapes
spec.description: Jobs that do not exist on a cluster (e.g. cilium-agent) simply do not appear.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"} == 1) unless on(namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Succeeded"} == 1))

label_replace(label_replace((sum by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas) - sum by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available)) > 0, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "kind", "Deployment", "namespace", ".*")

label_replace(label_replace((sum by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas) - sum by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready)) > 0, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "namespace", ".*")

label_replace(label_replace((sum by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled) - sum by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_number_ready)) > 0, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "namespace", ".*")

100 * (1 - avg by (nodename) ((rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~".*node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))

100 * (1 - sum by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) / sum by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))

max by (nodename, mountpoint) (((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job=~".*node-exporter",fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))

sum by (nodename) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job=~".*node-exporter",device=~"eth.*|ens.*|enp.*|eno.*|bond.*"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))

sum by (nodename) ((rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job=~".*node-exporter",device=~"eth.*|ens.*|enp.*|eno.*|bond.*"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info) * on(nodename) group_left() label_replace(kube_node_info, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))
